arxiv-2206-13992.title: Dynamical information flow within the magnetosphere-ionosphere system during magnetic storms
arxiv-2206-13992.creator: Mirko Stumpo, Simone Benella, GiuseppeConsolini, Tommaso Alberti
arxiv-2206-13992.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mirko Stumpo, Simone Benella, GiuseppeConsolini, Tommaso Alberti. The direct role of successive intense magnetospheric substorms in injecting/energizing particles into the storm-time ring current is still debated and controversial. Whereas in the recent past it has been observed the absence of a net information flow between magnetic storms and substorms, previous in-situ satellite observations have evidenced that ionospheric-origin ions dominate the population of the ring current during the main phase of geomagnetic storms.

arxiv-2212-02144.title: Low-Resolution Horizontal and Vertical Layered Mutual Information Maximizing LDPC Decoding
arxiv-2212-02144.creator: Philipp Mohr, Gerhard Bauch
arxiv-2212-02144.description: Abstract We investigate iterative low-resolution message-passing algorithms for quasi-cyclic LDPC codes with horizontal and vertical layered schedules. Coarse quantization and layered scheduling are highly relevant for hardware implementations to reduce the bit width of messages and the number of decoding iterations.

arxiv-2410-13281.title: BanTH : A Multi-label Hate Speech Detection Dataset for Transliterated Bangla
arxiv-2410-13281.creator: Fabiha Haider, Fariha Tanjim Shifat, Md Farhan Ishmam, Deeparghya, Dutta Barua, Md Sakib Ul Rahman Sourove, Md Fahim, Md Farhad Alam
arxiv-2410-13281.description: Abstract The proliferation of transliterated texts in digital spaces has emphasized the need for detecting and classifying hate speech in languages beyond English, particularly in low-resource languages. As online discourse can perpetuate discrimination based on target groups, e.g. gender, religion, and origin, multi-label classification of hateful content can help in understanding hate motivation and enhance content moderation.

arxiv-2412-14952.title: The impact of rotation on the stochastic excitation of stellar acoustic modes in solar-like pulsators
arxiv-2412-14952.creator: L. Bessila, A. Deckx van Ruys ,, V. Buriasco, S. Mathis, L. Bugnet, R.A. García, S. Mathur
arxiv-2412-14952.description: Abstract Context. Recent observational results from asteroseismic studies show that an important fraction of solar-like stars do not present detectable stochastically excited acoustic oscillations. This non-detectability seems to correlate with a high rotation rate in the convective envelope and a high surface magnetic activity. At the same time, the properties of stellar convection are affected by rotation and magnetism. Aims.

arxiv-2511-23325.title: Tackling a Challenging Corpus for Early Detection of Gambling Disorder: UNSL at MentalRiskES 2025
arxiv-2511-23325.creator: Horacio Thompson, Marcelo Errecalde
arxiv-2511-23325.description: Abstract Gambling disorder is a complex behavioral addiction that is challenging to understand and address, with severe physical, psychological, and social consequences. Early Risk Detection (ERD) on the Web has become a key task in the scientific community for identifying early signs of mental health behaviors based on social media activity.

pmc-10573683.title: Does Asthma Disrupt Psychological Wellbeing in Pregnancy?
pmc-10573683.creator: Paola C Fernández-Paredes, Eva Morales, Concepción Lopez-Soler, Luis Garcia-Marcos, on behalf of the NELA Study Group, Ildiko Horvath
pmc-10573683.description: (1) Background: Asthma is a very prevalent disease with special characteristics during pregnancy, however, little is known about its relationship to the psychological wellbeing of women in this period; we aimed to know whether depression and anxiety symptoms are more frequent in asthmatic pregnant women.

pmc-10595179.title: Effect of a health service integration on health care use of patients with alcohol disorders
pmc-10595179.creator: T Laatikainen, M-L Lamidi, K Wikström
pmc-10595179.description: BackgroundIn North Karelia, Finland an integration of all levels of health and social services was carried out in 2017. One of the usual targets in the service integration is to increase the performance of the service system especially in the care of patients with high use of services.

pmc-10808350.title: Microwave-assisted synthesis and development of novel penicillinoate@copper metal-organic frameworks as a potent antibacterial agent
pmc-10808350.creator: Adnan Hashim Abdulkadhim, Suhair Mohammad Husein Kamona, Haider Falih Shamikh Al-Saedi, Anmar Ghanim Taki, Abdul-Hameed. M. Hamoody, Sarah A. Hamood, Safia Obaidur Rab, Ahmed Ali Amir, Ashwaq Talib Kareem, Ahmed Alawadi, Ali Ihsan
pmc-10808350.description: Recently, nanoscience, especially metal–organic frameworks (MOFs), has been used to increase the effectiveness and properties of drugs. In this study, by using microwave irradiation; penicillin, which is a known antibiotic; and copper metal–organic frameworks (Cu-MOFs), a new penicillinoate@copper metal–organic framework (penicillinoate@Cu-MOF) was synthesized.

pmc-11325306.title: Exploring the Significance of Nurse Introduction for Positive Patient Experience in Saudi Arabia
pmc-11325306.creator: Mona Al Sherim, Sami Abdulrahman AL Hamidi
pmc-11325306.description: Empathy plays an important role in nursing so that the patients are provided with quality care and are satisfied with the services provided. Saudi Arabian patient interactions, including initial exploring, tend not to be formulaically initiated as in other countries.

pmc-11530658.title: Molecular dynamics investigation of epoxy resin adsorption mechanisms on clay surfaces and the mechanical properties of epoxy resin-clay
pmc-11530658.creator: Sijie Tao, Dejian Shen, Xin Wang, Lili Cai, Chunying Wu, Ruixin Liu
pmc-11530658.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The strength of natural clay can be improved with epoxy resins. However, nanoscale curing mechanisms remain poorly understood, which is essential for enhancing stability. In this study, molecular dynamics simulation was employed to calculate the quantity of interface hydrogen bonds, adsorption energy, radius of gyration, and mechanical properties of clay cured by diglycidyl ether of bisphenol-A epoxy resin (DGEBA), diglycidyl ether 4,4’-dihydroxy diphenyl sulfone (DGEDDS), and Aliphatic epoxidation of olefin resin (AEOR).

pmc-11642892.title: Combine Surgery and In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) in Endometriosis-Related Infertility: When and Why
pmc-11642892.creator: Irene Colombi, Alessandro Ginetti, Alberto Cannoni, Giulia Cimino, Claudia d’Abate, Giorgia Schettini, Matteo Giorgi, Diego Raimondo, Francesco Giuseppe Martire, Lucia Lazzeri, Errico Zupi, Gabriele Centini, Jacques Donnez
pmc-11642892.description: Endometriosis is a chronic, estrogen-dependent inflammatory disease characterized by the presence of endometrial tissue outside the uterus, causing pelvic pain and infertility. Infertility arises mainly due to inflammatory mediators in the peritoneal fluid, contributing to local hypoestrogenism, which appears to exacerbate chronic inflammation and sensitize pelvic nerves.

pmc-12491718.title: A telehealth lifestyle change program for rural Wisconsin, U.S. families at risk for diabetes: feasibility pilot results
pmc-12491718.creator: Susan J Andreae, Emily Hickey, Carol Van Hulle, Angela J Flickinger
pmc-12491718.description: ObjectivesFamily-based programs acknowledge that health behaviors are shaped by familial and environmental contexts. Since family history increases the risk for type-2 diabetes (T2DM), focusing on families may reduce modifiable risks in adults while promoting healthy habits in children. We conducted a 12-week telehealth pilot study with rural Wisconsin families to improve family health climate and reduce diabetes risk.

pmc-12639839.title: European public opinion and foreign policy. A continuity dataset (1952–1970)
pmc-12639839.creator: Luciana Fazio, Pierangelo Isernia
pmc-12639839.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This dataset pools together a series of surveys on foreign and defense policy issues conducted by the United States Information Agency (USIA) of the United States in Germany, Great Britain, France, and Italy between 1952 and 1970. The data have been collected from different sources and merged, to offer a continuity dataset, namely, a dataset that includes a set of questions that have been asked more than once over almost 20 years in all 4 countries.

pmc-12662088.title: Characterizations of a novel triple-reassortant H3N3 avian influenza A virus isolated from chickens in China
pmc-12662088.creator: Xinran Chu, Xuefeng Yin, Ye Tian, Wenjie Jiang, Zhehong Zhao, Jixiang Wang, Xudong Cao, Jianjun Sang, Quan Xie, Tuofan Li, Hongxia Shao, Aijian Qin, Jianqiang Ye, Zhimin Wan
pmc-12662088.description: The emergence of novel H3N8 and H10N3 avian influenza A viruses (IAVs) circulating in chicken flocks in China has raised significant concerns to their spillovers in humans and associated economic losses. In this study, we isolated a novel H3N3 strain from chickens exhibiting respiratory symptoms, designated as A/chicken/Shandong/118/2023(H3N3) (SD118).

pmc-12969754.title: Entheseal bone remodeling and patient reported outcomes in osteoarthritis – A quantitative [18F]NaF-PET MRI study
pmc-12969754.creator: Katharina Ziegeler, Virginie Kreutzinger, Lianne S. Gensler, Rupsa Bhattacharjee, Misung Han, Eric Hammond, Laura Chen, Emma Bahroos, Zehra Akkaya, Thomas M. Link, Richard B. Souza, Sharmila Majumdar
pmc-12969754.description: Objective:Entheses have been discussed as potential sources of pain in osteoarthritis (OA). Entheseal bone remodeling quantified by [18F]NaF-PET could be a surrogate marker for tensile forces causing a painful tissue response. This study aimed to investigate the relationship between [18 F]NaF-uptake, MRI findings and knee-related symptoms.

pmc-13069929.title: Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy Promotes Peripheral Nerve Regeneration Through ERK1/2‐Mediated Autophagy
pmc-13069929.creator: Xingdong Xiang, Xiaoqiong Wu, Shen Ling, Junwen Zhu, Jian Zhang, Tengfei Fu
pmc-13069929.description: Extracorporeal shock wave therapy (SWT) has shown potential in promoting peripheral nerve regeneration, yet its underlying mechanisms remain incompletely understood. In this study, we explored the role of extracellular signal‐regulated kinase 1/2 (ERK1/2)‐mediated autophagy in SWT‐enhanced nerve repair using both in vivo and in vitro models.

pmc-13206933.title: An Exploration of Machine Learning Methods in Human Biomonitoring
pmc-13206933.creator: Kavita Singh, Jiazhou Bi, Malo Musende, Sean P. Collins, Michael M. Borghese, Janice M.Y. Hu, Tyler Pollock, Annie St-Amand, Deirdre Hennessy, David L. Buckeridge
pmc-13206933.description: Highlights Public health relevance—How does this work relate to a public health issue? Chemical exposures are ubiquitous and can have adverse health impacts on individuals and populations. These exposures occur alongside many other determinants of health and disease risk factors. Advanced analytical methods are required to analyze multiple variables simultaneously and to fully understand their combined impacts.

pmc-13279470.title: Hepatitis B virus RNA levels and clinical characteristics of persistent viremia in HBsAg-positive patients undergoing nucleos(t)ide analog☆
pmc-13279470.creator: Yuzhu Shi, Yuchen Xie, Ying Chen, Xinru Guo, Li Yang, Xuedong Song, Fumin Feng, Jianhua Lu, Erhei Dai
pmc-13279470.description: Highlights•HBV RNA is an independent risk factor for persistent viremia (PV) during NAs therapy.•PV patients with positive HBV RNA exhibit more severe liver injury and cirrhosis.•Serum HBV RNA strongly correlates with HBeAg, reflecting cccDNA transcriptional activity.•Monitoring HBV RNA aids in risk stratification and guides optimized antiviral management.

pmc-13465015.creator: Jinmei Zhao, Huan Miao, Fang Wu, Juan Wei

pmc-13593668.title: P38α deficiency alleviates myocardial ischemia/reperfusion injury by stabilizing c‑Myc to inhibit ferroptosis
pmc-13593668.creator: Xiaohu Ouyang, Shuxin Song, Yalan Dong, Mi Xiang, Liangqingqing Yin, Xunxun Wang, Yan Ma, Yating Lu, Yaxuan Qi, Qingrui Nong, Hao Chen, Ruonan Yu, Alexey Sarapultsev, Xiang Cheng, Shanshan Luo, Desheng Hu
pmc-13593668.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Myocardial ischemia/reperfusion (I/R) injury constitutes a major clinical challenge in ischemic heart disease, and ferroptosis has been recognized as a core driver of cardiomyocyte death during reperfusion. However, the upstream regulatory network governing myocardial ferroptosis remains incompletely defined. The mitogen-activated protein kinase 14 (p38α, MAPK14) is a stress-activated kinase critically involved in cardiac pathophysiology, yet its role in I/R-induced ferroptosis remains unclear. Here, we report that p38α deficiency attenuates ferroptosis and protects against myocardial I/R injury by stabilizing c-Myc.
